python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, hashlib
from math import gcd

claims = [
    (112107027, 1018699967, 8149599737, 256, 1134913534),
    (819310576, 1032750773, 30982523191, 1073741824, 21367783975),
    (873153835, 1084101493, 36859450763, 17179869184, 23363711307),
]
for i,(x,n,p,g,h) in enumerate(claims,1):
    ok = pow(g,x,p)==h
    print(f"R{i} check:", ok)
    assert ok

ns = [c[1] for c in claims]
print("pairwise coprime:", all(gcd(ns[i],ns[j])==1 for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1,3)))

N = ns[0]*ns[1]*ns[2]
x = 0
for xi,n,*_ in claims:
    Ni = N//n
    x += xi * Ni * pow(Ni,-1,n)
x %= N
for xi,n,*_ in claims:
    assert x % n == xi
print("x =", x, "bound ok:", 0 <= x < N)
checksum = hashlib.sha256(f"dlog-2x2-v1:joint:{x}".encode()).hexdigest()
print("checksum:", checksum)
json.dump({"secret": x, "checksum": checksum}, open("answer.json","w"))
EOF
